result.instructions: Tools for Bitly, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Shorten https://example.com/spring-sale and tell me the bitlink."; "Which of our bitlinks got the most clicks this month?"; "How many scans did our spring QR code get last week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bitly data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bitly_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bitly_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bitly_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. bitly_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bitly_get_user
tools.title: Get the signed-in user
tools.description: Return the Bitly user that owns the access token (login, name, default group). Bitly API: GET /v4/user.

tools.name: bitly_list_organizations
tools.title: List organizations
tools.description: List the Bitly organizations this user belongs to. Bitly API: GET /v4/organizations.

include_all.description: Include organizations the user is no longer active in.

tools.name: bitly_get_plan_limits
tools.title: Get plan limits
tools.description: Return the monthly plan limits and usage for an organization (API calls, short links, custom back-halves, redirects). Bitly API: GET /v4/organizations/{organization_guid}/plan_limits.

tools.name: bitly_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the Bitly groups (workspaces) the user can see, optionally in one organization. Bitly API: GET /v4/groups.

tools.name: bitly_get_group
tools.title: Get a group
tools.description: Return one Bitly group with its settings and organization. Bitly API: GET /v4/groups/{group_guid}.

group_guid.description: Group GUID, for example Ba1bc23dE4F (from bitly_list_groups).

tools.name: bitly_list_group_bitlinks
tools.title: List bitlinks in a group
tools.description: List the bitlinks (short links) in a group, newest first, with filters. Page with search_after from the last result. Bitly API: GET /v4/groups/{group_guid}/bitlinks.

group_guid.description: Group GUID, for example Ba1bc23dE4F (from bitly_list_groups).

search_after.description: Cursor from the previous page's pagination.search_after.

query.description: Free-text search over the link text.

archived.description: on = only archived, off = only active (default off), both = all.

created_before.description: Unix timestamp; only links created before it.

created_after.description: Unix timestamp; only links created after it.

tools.name: bitly_get_group_clicks
tools.title: Get group clicks over time
tools.description: Return click counts for every link in a group, bucketed by unit. Bitly API: GET /v4/groups/{group_guid}/clicks.

group_guid.description: Group GUID, for example Ba1bc23dE4F (from bitly_list_groups).

unit.description: Time unit for the buckets (default day).

units.description: How many units to return; -1 returns all (default -1).

unit_reference.description: ISO 8601 timestamp that ends the window (default now).

tools.name: bitly_get_bitlink
tools.title: Get a bitlink
tools.description: Return one bitlink: its long URL, title, tags, archive state and creation time. Bitly API: GET /v4/bitlinks/{bitlink}.

bitlink.description: Bitlink as domain/hash, for example bit.ly/12a4b6c.

tools.name: bitly_get_bitlink_clicks
tools.title: Get bitlink clicks over time
tools.description: Return click counts for one bitlink, bucketed by unit. Bitly API: GET /v4/bitlinks/{bitlink}/clicks.

bitlink.description: Bitlink as domain/hash, for example bit.ly/12a4b6c.

unit.description: Time unit for the buckets (default day).

units.description: How many units to return; -1 returns all (default -1).

unit_reference.description: ISO 8601 timestamp that ends the window (default now).

tools.name: bitly_get_bitlink_clicks_summary
tools.title: Get a bitlink click total
tools.description: Return the total clicks for one bitlink over a window. Bitly API: GET /v4/bitlinks/{bitlink}/clicks/summary.

bitlink.description: Bitlink as domain/hash, for example bit.ly/12a4b6c.

unit.description: Time unit for the buckets (default day).

units.description: How many units to return; -1 returns all (default -1).

unit_reference.description: ISO 8601 timestamp that ends the window (default now).

tools.name: bitly_get_qr_code
tools.title: Get a QR code
tools.description: Return one Bitly QR code: its destination, design and short link. Bitly API: GET /v4/qr-codes/{qrcode_id}.

qrcode_id.description: QR code id from bitly_list_group_bitlinks or the QR code creation response.

tools.name: bitly_get_qr_code_scans_summary
tools.title: Get QR code scan total
tools.description: Return the total scans for one QR code over a window. Bitly API: GET /v4/qr-codes/{qrcode_id}/scans/summary.

unit.description: Time unit for the buckets (default day).

units.description: How many units to return; -1 returns all (default -1).

unit_reference.description: ISO 8601 timestamp that ends the window (default now).

tools.name: bitly_shorten_link
tools.title: Shorten a link
tools.description: Shorten a long URL into a bitlink. Without force_new_link, Bitly returns the existing bitlink for the same URL. With force_new_link=true, each call creates another bitlink, so do not retry it. Bitly API: POST /v4/shorten.

long_url.description: The full URL to shorten, including https://.

domain.description: Short domain, for example bit.ly (default: the group's default).

group_guid.description: Group that owns the link (default: the user's default group).

force_new_link.description: true = create a new bitlink even if one exists for this URL.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Bitly
prompts.description: What you can do with Bitly here, with example requests to try.
